shellCommands.command: find app -type f | head -50 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json
cat app/lib/auth.ts && echo "---LAYOUT---" && cat app/layout.tsx && echo "---PAGE---" && cat app/page.tsx

grep -r "forbidden" node_modules/next/navigation.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.* 2>/dev/null | grep -i "export\|forbidden" | head; echo "---"; cat node_modules/next/navigation.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/forbidden.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "authInterrupts\|experimental\|enabled" | head; echo "---FORBIDDEN-ERROR---"; ls node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | grep -i forbidden

for i in $(seq 1 30); do if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "ready after ${i}s"; break; fi; sleep 1; done; echo "--- /admin status ---"; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin

grep -o "403\|Forbidden\|don't have permission\|Return home" /tmp/admin.html | sort -u; echo "--- dev log (errors/warnings) ---"; grep -iE "error|warn|authInterrupts|✓|ready|compiled" /tmp/next-dev.log | head -20
pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; git status --short
